title: DRDA: Make sure a parameter length value is non zero
description:
Since the parameter length includes the length bytes, and is what we
advance the offset by, check and make sure that it's large enough for
the header to avoid a possible infinite loop. In another case, handle
it similarly to prevent overflow (though the zero case is handled a
little differently there already.)

Coverity CIDs 1680610 and 1680621
